rows.grounds: past passive participle describing affected beings

items.question: By what count and in what contexts are beings said to be tormented according to this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the relevant groups.
These groups are located among thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings within those womb-diagrams are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The exact identity of the beings remains unspecified.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams contain tormented beings.
